Transcript: (approx 2 minutes)

“Theydies, gentlethems, people and creatures of all ages, we’re back with the truth here on Empire City Post Radio, with your ever gracious host, Finn Midask!

Now everyone, it has been an eventful weekend with reports of Pigeon-Rat-Roach attacks in pedestrian parks and tales of rebellion around the city as the pressure begins to rise.

Redcoats have drastically upped the frequency in which they harass citizens and they expect us to just sit with it? No. They have started cracking down on curfews as an excuse to disarm us, throw us into jail, and forget we exist.

Recently, they began experimenting with targeted profiling. Having sketch wizards create generic archetypes of different races here in Empire City and putting them up everywhere. It’s an effective fear mongering tactic, making you think you have seen a wanted criminal when you head to the ordinary for a pint!

THESE ARE FRAUDULENT. STAY SAFE EMPIRE CITY. They are Bogus wanted posters designed to give redcoats free reign to detain anyone and “Ask questions later after processing”. If you see them up, RIP THEM DOWN while none of them are looking.

In other news we do have reports of brave vigilantes targeting and engaging redcoats. Could they be part of Washington’s Minutemen here to keep us safe? The violence erupted after a set of two redcoats were found unconscious and robbed of everything but their clothes in an attempt to re-arm and re-armor our people.

The 2nd skirmish was much more public early this morning with a small group maneuvering around Hampstead Streets before having a bloody fight with a patrol of redcoats. From the remaining blood, heavy wounds were suffered on both sides, but the bodies left behind were that of Redcoats. Our patriots have triumphed by the hair of lady luck herself.

With news of the greater war coming to us, our beloved public library was destroyed in a bombing after hours. No casualties were recorded but it is unknown whether this was targeted or collateral after Washington’s men redirected it away from civilian homesteads.

Now for the dailies: keep wary of Ferrytown’s fares. Don’t get caught without a way home if you can help it and please do not accept the help of any patrons that live there. Exciting games of skill are currently available to play for reward so test out your power while you can!

Keep up the good fight folks and never back down. This has been your evergracious Finn Midask of the Golden Voice tuning in with the truth.”

Transcript: Approx 3 minutes
"Theydies, Gentlethems, people of all ages, the truth is back today with your vigilant host Finn Midask. 

It's been a bloody night and morning for citizens of Empire City. Beginning with discovered traps and monsters lurking about the old clocktower. If you're an adventurous type looking to brave it, don't go without a healer, that's for sure!

An update to the rat roach found in Central Park, a colony seemed to have been coalescing in the underground sewers. Normally we'd put an ad out for a well equipped adventuring exterminator but a toxic fume has arisen making it impossible to safely breathe in the area. 

This brings into question the sanctity of our water supply. Who is sabotaging and corrupting the area and what are their objectives? 

Additionally, the reports sent forth by Mortician Aljarad Smith about several missing persons in the sewer resulted in the casualties of over 6 citizens with upwards of a dozen others badly wounded. 

No trail of evidence or leads suggested missing persons made it into the sewer, calling up the validity of these reports into question. Loyalist Aljarad Smith has been unavailable for comments despite sending a great many self identified patriots to their demise. 

Was this so he may profit more in his business? Is it for pleasure or an honest mistake? 
One thing's for sure, the sewers are dangerous and hold no place for the citizens above to go through. 

With the mists rolled in and the Noir acting up, stay safe when traversing those areas, stay inside unless absolutely necessary. 

Hampstead News has shared notice to try and quarter redcoats into your houses, do NOT let them do so. If some attempt to force themselves in, let us know. Leave a message or send a letter to Empire City Post and we'll bring help your way.

Now for the most recent and pressing development. 4pm today a jailed patriot by the name of <@!467139287192829977> was brought forward by Redcoats, bruised and bloodied with maltreatment, to be executed as an example without trial, intimidating civilians to never stand up and fight for what is right. Something much more powerful happened however. A hymn started by Eldon himself rang out and inspired the crowd of everyday people that wanted to get by.

Scores of patriots took to acting in an attempt to free, not their leader, but a symbol of freedom. The redcoats, in a blazing fire atop the platform slaughtered the defenseless man mercilessly. A bloody engagement ensued leaving at least 2 redcoats dead and many more wounded. 

Although the attempt to save this patriot failed, he will remain a symbol that represents the cost worth paying for freedom. He is survived by his brother Camus, another patriot that continues to fight on. 

Stay safe Empire City and look out for your fellow citizens. In remembrance we shall be playing the song that inspired others to rise. This is Finn Midask with the Truth signing off."

“Hello survivors of Empire City. If you’re hearing this, it means you have found somewhere to lie low, or you found yourself in a jail cell. Today is a sad day.

We were bested. Out gunned, outmanned, outnumbered and outplanned. We lost this battle, but the heart of the city perseveres for the war. Do not get caught outside. Regroup at the moorage or with whomever you can find.

“Hello Empire city! It’s back with your revolutionary host Finn Midask! Yesterday we suffered a great setback, but I am blown away by all the support and resilience the people of the EC have shown!

After a daring jail break in the city, finding groups of citizens taking to the streets with an illusory army and a passion to beat the heads in of some lobster backs, we were able to retaliate effectively! 

The redcoat forces backed off for unknown reasons, partly due to an overextension on their end, but for another conspiracy we are actively working to uncover.

In other news, a problem has surfaced in Central Park. What has been identified as a bomb was actively disarmed until it activated in the early morning. It seems to be burrowing for something. What that is, we are yet to find out.

Ben Franklin has been spotted actively investigating the subject. We will report more as details arise.

If you’re available in the meantime theydies and gentlethems, and happen to be a strong swimmer or can make it to a boat, join us in investigating disturbances happening in the water outside Ferrytown.

But back to the inspiring folks of Empire City, you are what keeps this town alive. Every brick you have put together, every wall you have helped rebuild. If I could be any more inspired, it would be full thanks to you.

Whatever is happening in this city, stay safe and be whelmed. We’ll be readily available.

Additionally, start making use of your funds to take to the skies and join the revolution! The more forces we have the fewer redcoats will be left to bother us. We want YOU to join TODAY.

Friday evening we found Champ, a baby Kraken in the harbor outside Ferrytown getting attacked by several Dorba-chu creatures.

At 4pm feel free to meet at The Golden Voice in order to prepare yourself. I will give a briefing and prepare you for the fight to come! We’ll organize and show them not to mess with our city!

“Empire City we have correspondence and reporting on the war from our own accounts. Taking the fight to the air, this is your host Captain Finn Midask with the truth.

Yesterday afternoon an important member of the Continental Banking Alliance put faith in the crew of the Wounded Duck to be smuggled past enemy lines for an important meeting. This critical backer keeping the patriot’s interest’s funded is a high value target that the revolution could not afford to lose. 

Valiantly, yankees of our beloved cities snuck into the skies and blew past a set of high border patrol airships. Outright crippling one and outrunning the other before any reinforcements could react gave us the head start we needed to deliver him safely.

Ensuring the city’s future by funding the rebellion is something every person should and can take part in. With a price as low as 16 gold per stock, it is a steal. Theydies and gentlethems I must repeat, head to Wallstreet and purchase as much CON stock as you can. That is Continental Currency Bills and together, we can fund a better tomorrow. Whether you’re a house spouse, pigeon wrangler, or keen adventurer, this is a choice we all profit with.

In addition to this escort mission I had the pleasure of joining an undercover sabotage mission to steal airships for our cause. You may have heard of the Cloud Giant. A magnificently built terror in the skies. That’s no cloud, that’s a lobster tank.

Together, heroes of the resistance infiltrated their flying fortress and stole a score of ships and crippled many more. A day is soon coming that we will find air superiority in our own skies once again, but until then, prepare your crews and get ready. More details on raiding opportunities to come, stop by the Samuel Adams for more.

Additionally in the night, the reported snipers were killed or captured due to our further warning. If you don’t feel like you can provide a fight but still have that fighting spirit, your information saves lives too!

On another note, we are looking for backers to sponsor an orphanage to help with the children left behind after the red coat invasion. If you are interested in organizing please seek my assistant, Julie, to find out how you can help.

On a more local and strange occurrence, sightings of a figure known only as Malathor has been spotted planting seeds across the city. A benevolent peaceful tree hugger or a malicious and crazy arch druid is up to you to decide, but one thing’s for sure, we can’t wait to see what we’ll sow next.

This has been Finn Midask with the Truth, Signing Off.”
